#0 ogdoad — violet fullness; the branches counted 10·12 → 30/15 (the order the crisis will disturb); ⊙ dimming as the others' longing is restrained; attract/pulse — the conjunct world; no automation (the stillness before the passion).

#1 horos — THE SEPARATING SCENE: Sophia's reach walked — out, strained dim toward the depth, returned bright to her conjunction; the boundary triangle names itself Horos as it acts; repel/shove at full strength — the limit that bounds and sustains; the enthymesis disc excluded at the rim; the amorphous-birth variant triangle kept visibly separate (never silenced).

#2 soter — ring layout: the fullness gathered; ⁂ → Soter (the contributions composing the common fruit, arriving at the Soter's station); attract/pulse — thanksgiving and rest; auto-rest LFO on dispersion (the shared quiet).

#3 achamoth — the longest beat (15): formed once by the earlier Christ (disc brightening), formed twice by the Soter (brighter); IAO cried at the boundary triangle; vortex/pulse — the passions' churning becoming cosmos; the affect-table ≈⚰ held centre.

#4 demiurge — grid layout (the ordered substances); 7·8 → 7 (his knowledge bounded at the Hebdomas, his mother's Ogdoad outside his sight); attract/implode — the hidden agency drawing the making; auto-order triangle LFO (the ordering labour); ◉ the human with the placed seed.

#5→0 bridal return — THE 3D SCENE. z is the return's layers: the Offered comparison nearest (0/1 → A13·A19 at z +0.3, human-amplified: no kept in view), the bridal chamber breathing at z 0, the Demiurge's reward at z −0.2, fire deepest (z −0.35) consuming matter and finally itself; pointer attract/pulse firmest — the union gathering; auto-bridal LFO on pointerStrength.

ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's counted fullness (30/15) rested on conjunctions; #1's solitary reach broke measure and was restored by a limit that sustains what it bounds — the excluded passion persisting outside; #5→0 returns as bridal union joined by differentiated destinations (Demiurge dwelling, souls resting, fire self-consuming) with the comparison kept Offered and nearest: the formed four asked whether it can disclose the two implicated conditions — the beginning's reach, limit and contribution re-read without being claimed as proof. The naming-guard held: Achamoth's exile never re-exiles upper Sophia.

Human-amplified guards carried (amplification relations: all Offered, human-amplified: no): no new symbolic ratification; the image returns to A13 without becoming its proof; the source-to-psychic comparison unratified. Source-led discipline: Irenaeus's accusations, rebuttals and satirical sweat proposal remain his own voices (kept as change of speaker); licentiousness allegations remain polemic; variants marked, not episodes; the translation tension between substantial formation and later intelligence retained; the 'some' of I.7.2 a marked fourfold-Christology variant; royal-mosaic image Irenaeus's own refutation. Mythemic verbs only: the report displays a restored limit and a collective contribution.

Automation: auto-rest (the shared quiet), auto-order (the ordering labour), auto-bridal (the union gathering) — tied to the record's moves; #0, #1, #3 held without automation (the stillness, the limit, the passion are their own times). Durations 12–15, transitions 1.3–2.0.

glyph_rationales.the Ogdoad — the four primary conjunctio: The primary Ogdoad: Bythus—Sige, Nous—Aletheia, Logos—Zoe, Anthropos—Ecclesia — the fullness articulated through conjunction.
glyph_rationales.the Decad — five pairs from Logos and Zo: The Decad: further generation through the branch of Logos and Zoe — five conjunctions.
glyph_rationales.the Duodecad — six pairs from Anthropos: The Duodecad: six conjunctions from Anthropos and Ecclesia; Sophia, joined to Theletos, its youngest.
glyph_rationales.Nous alone comprehends the Father; the r: Only Nous comprehends the Father; Sige restrains his wish to communicate; each Aeon quietly longs for the root without beginning — the shared desire preceding Sophia's crisis.
glyph_rationales.Sophia's solitary reach — apart from The: The passion: she strains into the Father's depth apart from her consort and comes close to dissolution in his sweetness.
glyph_rationales.Horos / Stauros — the same power establi: Horos: the same power establishes and divides — the boundary that supports Sophia while separating her passion; Stauros names the sustaining function, Horos the separating.
glyph_rationales.the enthymesis — the intention excluded: The enthymesis: the intention arising from her passion, separated and excluded — the life that persists beyond the boundary.
glyph_rationales.the amorphous-birth variant — a second a: The variant telling: an amorphous birth with grief, fear and supplication — kept distinguishable from the near-dissolution account.
glyph_rationales.the earlier Christ — produced by Monogen: The earlier Christ: teaching the nature of the conjunctions and the Father's incomprehensibility, so the Aeons will not suffer a similar passion.
glyph_rationales.the Holy Spirit — bringing the Aeons to: The Holy Spirit: bringing the Aeons to thanksgiving and rest, their private striving ceased.
glyph_rationales.the contributions — each Aeon's most bea: The common fruit: each contributes what is most beautiful; the Father approves, Christ and the Spirit concur.
glyph_rationales.the Soter — called also Christ, Logos an: The Soter: the collective fruit whose common origin gives the Aeons' contributions a consequence beyond their restored rest.
glyph_rationales.Achamoth in darkness and vacuity — forml: Outside the Pleroma: the expelled enthymesis without form in darkness and vacuity — the lower Sophia of the subsequent story.
glyph_rationales.the first formation — according to subst: The first formation: the Christ extends beyond Stauros, gives her form according to substance, then withdraws, leaving an odour of immortality.
glyph_rationales.the second formation — according to inte: The second formation: the Soter comes with his angels; she first veils herself before their splendour, then receives strength and meets his coming — formed according to intelligence, her passions healed into substrates.
glyph_rationales.the affects becoming substrates — tears: Affective cosmogenesis: tears give liquid substance, remembered light makes her smile and the lucid arise, grief yields the corporeal; conversion generates the psychic order.
glyph_rationales.Horos stops her crossing back — the cry: The barred passage: her attempt to cross back is stopped by Horos; the report associates the exclamation Iao with that barrier.
glyph_rationales.the spiritual offspring — conceived in t: The spiritual seed: freed of her passions, she looks upon the Soter's angels and conceives offspring in their likeness — a different origin from the material and psychic substrates.
glyph_rationales.Achamoth — moving him without making her: The hidden mother: her agency remains hidden from the maker she produces.
glyph_rationales.the Demiurge — ordering the substances,: The Demiurge: separating and ordering the substances, making corporeal things, ruling the sevenfold power — effective within his world.
glyph_rationales.the seven heavens — above them Achamoth': The regions: seven heavens below, Achamoth's intermediate Ogdoad dwelling above him, the Pleroma beyond — repeated names, distinct regions.
glyph_rationales.the elements and their affects — earth:: The second elemental differentiation: earth the fixed stupor, water fear's movement, air grief, fire inherent in the three as ignorance in the passions.
glyph_rationales.the human — earth formed, psychic breath: The earthly human: formed of fluid substance, breathing the psychic principle, clothed with skins; Achamoth places the spiritual seed within the Demiurge without his knowledge.
glyph_rationales.the bridal chamber — Achamoth joined to: The consummation: Achamoth enters the Pleroma as bride; the spiritual become brides of the angels — the generation from their sight reaching its union.
glyph_rationales.the Demiurge restored to the intermediat: The other destinations: the Demiurge passes into the dwelling Achamoth has left; righteous psychic souls rest there without entering the Pleroma.
glyph_rationales.fire consuming matter and finally itself: The end of matter: fire, hidden until its moment, consumes matter and finally itself — material existence cannot receive incorruptibility.
glyph_rationales.the founding comparison, Offered — the r: The Offered comparison: solitary reach, restored limit and joint contribution set beside 0/1→4+2 — a comparison, not a ratified derivation; the two implicate conditions retained.
